verdict.rationale: A government IP registry could plausibly offer programmatic or API access for automated searching, filing or tracking, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no headless, API or CI-capable interface. It describes only online forms, email or post filing, and a One Login credential requirement, and the probe notes that the trade-mark search host blocks keyless agents at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
